picker.title: Choose a format
picker.subtitle: The format is the first decision of every edit. It sets the canvas, the track layout and the scorecard the edit is checked against, by you and by the agent.
picker.anyVariantHint: Pooled targets across the variants; pick one when you know the pace.
picker.noFormatDescription: Custom canvas and plain V1 / A1 tracks. You can set a format later.
picker.chooseFirst: Choose a format above, or No format.

panel.noFormatBody: Choose a format to get its track layout, its rules and a live scorecard of this timeline. The agent reads it too.
panel.scoringMain: Scoring Main: open it to rescore.
panel.empty: Add clips to the timeline to score the edit.
panel.jumpedTo: At {{index}} of {{count}}: click for the next
panel.showRanges: Mark failing ranges on the timeline
panel.allowSpeedRampsHint: No format uses speed ramps. Allow them here and the scorecard stops warning about ramped clips in this project.

change.title: Change format
change.description: The scorecard is re-targeted at the new format. Nothing on the timeline is moved or deleted.
change.addTracksHint: New empty tracks, placed by the format's layout. Existing tracks and clips stay where they are.
change.mainOnly: Open the main timeline to add tracks.
change.noMissing: Every track this format needs is already on the timeline.

chip.open: Project specs: format, scorecard, canvas and notes

guide.title: {{format}} guide
guide.description: How this format is cut, from its research. The scorecard checks the numbers.

specs.title: Project specs
specs.description: The project's format, its scorecard, the style kit, the canvas and the notes for the agent.
specs.nothingSelectedBody: Select a clip to edit it. The format, scorecard, canvas and notes are in Project specs.

style.noBridge: The style kit is edited through the local Shreditor service, which is not running.
style.noKit: This project has no Video Style Kit. Ask Claude to apply one (shred kit apply) and its fonts, looks and preferences show here.
style.drift: The kit file changed since this project applied it. Ask Claude to re-apply it (shred kit apply) before editing it here.
style.unreadable: The kit file can't be read: {{error}}
style.unsaved: The editor could not save its changes first. Try again.
style.hint: Saving updates kit.json (logged in its changelog) and restyles this project's kit titles, captions and overlays. Anything else in the kit: ask Claude.
